search_window.basis: Start anchored to the completed_at timestamp of the immediately preceding read-back verified 09:49:52 PST heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger. Retrieval broadened two days to allow indexing lag; only new qualifying access disruptions substantiated since that completed_at timestamp are eligible.

coverage_notes.observation: No new verifiable U.S. food-access disruption in the four narrowly specified classes within the hourly observation interval. Search results consisted largely of pre-window grocery fires, earlier food-bank flooding/closure, older agency shutdown notices, routine service calendars, reopening stories, and a non-interruption SNAP policy eligibility change. Results were screened by underlying publication/incident dates, not crawl dates.

duplicate_screen.method: Listed dated ledger directory on ops/watch-ledger and fetched latest persisted hourly heartbeat before filtering fresh web search results.

coverage_notes.limitations: No tool-level search failures. Targeted search indexes yielded sparse directly relevant local/provider notices; recency filters can surface historical pages. Nonappearance in these 12 targeted queries is not proof of absence; coverage is supplementary rather than exhaustive.
coverage_notes.production_authority: No approvals, publications, production collector changes, schedule changes, or task disabling.
